A working catalogue of taps, pumps, spigots and fountains

The Tap Atlas

Twenty-eight ways people get water out of a pipe, a tank or the ground, from a bronze stopcock nearly two thousand years old to a water ATM you pay for by phone. Choose one and you are standing at the basin in 3D, close enough to touch it. Your pointer becomes a hand: twist, lift, pump, press or wave, then hold your hand in the stream to feel how hot it runs. Scroll to lean in or step back. Turn your sound on.
